output.narrative: The attack began with multiple attempts to gain access using decoded strings and initial execution of scripts via base64 encoding and curl commands. Sandcat was then deployed and persisted through nohup, while monitoring processes and network sockets indicated discovery activities. PowerShell was also used to execute malicious payloads over HTTPS.
